title: Cost Control
meta: Choose the right AI model size, set usage limits and see where your spend goes. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: AI cost control: right-sized models and usage limits
overview: AI bills can climb quietly. We read your usage from your provider account, find which features cost the most and test whether a smaller or cheaper model gives answers that are good enough. Then we set daily caps, shorter instructions and caching where it makes sense. You get a simple cost report and a monthly forecast, so you know what a busy week costs before it happens.

pkgs.blurb: A cost check on one AI feature with quick wins listed.
Cheaper model tests plus caps and alerts in your account.
Full cost set-up with caching, forecast and per-user limits.
list: Test of up to 4 model options

faq: Will a cheaper model hurt quality?
Sometimes, and sometimes not at all. We run your own real examples through each option and show the answers side by side with the cost. You choose the trade-off, and we only switch what you approve.
Do you need access to my AI provider account?
Read access to usage and billing pages is enough for the review. To set caps we need you to add us as a team member with limited rights. We never ask for your password or card details.
It depends on your set-up, so we do not promise a number. We show the measured cost of each option on your own examples so you can decide. Many tools use a larger model than the task needs.
Does this cover cloud server bills?
This service looks at AI usage costs. For servers, databases and hosting spend, the cloud cost review on our cloud hosting page covers that.
